strings.이 지독한 기운…, 제가 알고 있는 데이모스 교단의 것이 아닙니다. 아니: This dreadful presence... It isn't the energy of the Order of Deimos that I know. No, it feels as though something else is mixed in...
I feel it too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.
strings.여기에서 나오는 이질적인 존재들을 처리하고 안에 들어가는 것까지 하기엔: It would take too long to deal with these alien beings and then make our way inside.
strings.그래서 밖으로 나오는 존재들을 베는 동안, %s 님께서 안으로 들어가셔서: While I cut down the creatures emerging from it, I'd like you to go inside, %s. See for yourself whether it's an ominous presence or a trace of the relic.
strings.제가 가도 될까요?: Are you sure I should go?
strings.%s 님은 스승님께서 인정하셨을 뿐만 아니라, 제가 할 수 없는 일을 하: My master has recognized your abilities, %s. And you can do things I cannot.
strings.저도 엘에게 인정받은 걸까요?: Does that mean I've earned your recognition too, Ell?
I simply respect people with talent, whatever their field.
Just don't tease me about being afraid of... ghosts and such.
Now, let's hurry. That's enough chatting.
Yes. I'll get moving as well.
So this is my master's homeland...
strings.오라버니와 날 거두신 스승님을 위해 이곳의 일을 완벽하게 마무리하고 돌아: For the master who took in my brother and me, I must finish our work here properly before returning.
strings.(허무의 별에서 제일 깊은 곳, 수상한 기운이 느껴진다.): (Deep in the Star of the Void, you sense something suspicious.)
I wandered all the way in here, but that thing over there...
strings.(수상한 기운을 품고 있는 뱀 형상의 존재가 빤히 바라보고 있다.): (A serpentine being, shrouded in a suspicious aura, stares intently at you.)
strings.내가 있는 곳을 용케도 찾은 거 보면 그가 이끈 게 분명해. 하여튼, 기: You did well to find me. He must have guided you. In any case, I've been waiting, master of the cards.
strings.잠깐, 날 알고 있어? 일반적인 뱀은 아닌 것 같은데…. 사람의 말을 하: Wait, you know me? You're no ordinary snake... A snake that speaks! Could you be Ouroboros?!
So you know his name. Just as I thought... But I am not he.
strings.문득 그가 너에게 했던 말이 떠오르는군. 자신의 할 일에 큰 방해가 된다: I'm reminded of what he said to you. That you would be a great hindrance to his work! That he would regret not disposing of you then and there!
strings.왜 그리 성급해. 내가 비록 그는 아니지만, 그의 그림자…. 뱀 그림자라: Why so impatient? Though I am not he, I am his shadow... You may call me the Serpent's Shadow.
strings.다시 한 번 묻겠다. 우로보로스는 어디에 있지?: I'll ask you again. Where is Ouroboros?
You're tiresome. Let me tell you something other than where he is.
strings.어디부터 어디까지 이야기할까? 너와 같은 영혼을 가진 사람이 한둘이 아니: Where shall I begin, and where shall I end? Perhaps with the fact that you are far from the only person with a soul like yours?
strings.(뱀 그림자의 말에서 갑자기 오싹한 기분이 느껴진다.): (A sudden chill runs through you at the Serpent's Shadow's words.)
strings.이해하진 못해도 본능적으로 느끼고 있네?: You may not understand, but you sense it instinctively, don't you?
strings.그의 의지가 말하고 있어. 너를 삼키라고. 너를 삼키면 이곳의 신들도 자: His will speaks to me. It tells me to devour you. That if he devours you, even the gods of this place will acknowledge him.
strings.(갑자기 뱀 그림자가 입맛을 다신다.): (The Serpent's Shadow suddenly licks its lips.)
strings.내가 여기서 너를 만난 건, '운명'이라 말하는 그의 의지야. 그러니 내: Our meeting here is his will—the thing he calls fate. So I will swallow you whole.
I will devour anything that stands in his way. That is my purpose.
strings.하지만, 신이 이 세계의 운명을 바꾼 것처럼 나도 그러고 싶어졌어. 네가: And yet, just as a god changed this world's fate, I now wish to do the same. With the power you possess, perhaps even I could break free of his will...
strings.너는 우로보로스의 그림자면서 그를 거스르는군. 신이 되고 싶은 거야?: You're Ouroboros's shadow, yet you defy him. Do you want to become a god?
No, more than that... You seem to know something.
strings.네가 찾는 걸 다 알고 있을지도? 네가 진실을 감당할 수 없다면 그냥 삼: Perhaps I know everything you seek. If you cannot bear the truth, letting yourself be devoured would be the wiser choice. Now, choose.
strings.원하지 않는다고 해서 발동될 의지를 멈출 순 없다. 내가, 그리고 그가: Your refusal cannot stop the will that is about to be unleashed. I desire it, and so does he.
I'll make you regret those words. Finding Ouroboros is the way to protect everyone.
strings.(뱀 그림자가 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 입을 크게 벌려 거대한 송곳니를 드러: (No sooner has it finished speaking than the Serpent's Shadow opens its jaws wide, baring enormous fangs.)
Impossible... His will, overcome by a mere human...
Even if I am only a shadow...
strings.(뱀 그림자의 움직임이 둔해진다. 그러다 점차 모습이 흐릿해지기 시작한다: (The Serpent's Shadow slows. Then its form begins to fade.)
He no longer permits me to exist...
strings.오랫동안 그의 의지를 지키고자 살아왔던 내가 인간에게 밀렸다는 이유만으로: After all these years spent upholding his will... Simply because a human defeated me...
strings.내가 대답하지 않아도, 네 의지가 그를 찾을 것이다. 너는 보통 인간이: Even without my answer, your will shall find him. You are no ordinary human.
strings.루미너스 시티의 평범한 학생이 마나카드를 손에 넣었어. 나는 그때부터 다: I was an ordinary student in Luminous City who came into possession of Mana Cards. Ever since then, I haven't been able to go back.
You truly know nothing of yourself. You don't even know the truth of the cards. Hehe... The road to oblivion does suit you.
The one who rose from human to god knows far too little as well. If you wish to know...
strings.그게 무슨 소리지? 말해!!: What are you talking about? Tell me!
strings.내가 사라진 자리에서 신이 모르고 있는 진실을 보게 해라. 그녀가 제일: Let the god look upon the place where I disappear, and see the truth she does not know. She will give you the wisest answer.
Ouroboros... How could you leave me like this... Like...
strings.우로보로스, 대답해!! 어디 있어?! 날 보고 있지?: Ouroboros, answer me! Where are you?! You're watching me, aren't you?
%s, I'm sorry to appear so suddenly...
The Serpent's Shadow said to look where it disappeared...
It seems to be something only I can see. Something visible only to my eyes...
Let me take a look, then I'll tell you.
strings.(이리스의 환영이 뱀 그림자가 사라진 자리를 빤히 응시한다.): (Iris's apparition gazes intently at the place where the Serpent's Shadow disappeared.)
strings.(왜 이 기억들이 떠오르지. 이리스가 보고 있는 것도 이 기억들인가?): (Why am I remembering these things? Is Iris seeing these memories too?)
strings.(이리스가 궁금해하는 사람, 니이인 것 같다. ): (The person Iris is asking about seems to be Nii.)
I am Nii, guardian of Luminous City...
strings.(니이…. 니이의 모습이 선명하게 떠오른다. 잘 있을까?): (Nii... I can picture Nii clearly. I wonder how things are going.)
strings.루미너스 시티의 사람들은 아직 그 존재를 모르지만, 머지 않아 루미너스: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of their existence, but before long, Luminous too will become part of these worlds.
strings.우리가 이 세계의 붕괴를 막기 위해 이곳에 남아있는 한, 우로보로스를 쫓: As long as we remain here to prevent this world's collapse, you alone can pursue Ouroboros.
strings.(오딘, 미안…. 난 아직 제대로 찾지 못했어.): (Odin, I'm sorry... I still haven't found him.)
strings.(이리스를 위해 빨리 초인의 힘을 더 얻어야 해….): (I need to gain more of the Champions' power quickly, for Iris...)
This is no time for that. The child Ouroboros has taken captive...
Beyond time, into the world of the past... My beloved child of destiny...
strings.(엘리? 왜 저런 말을 하는 거야? 으윽…, 알 수 없는 고통이 느껴져…: (Ellie? Why is she saying that? Urgh... An unfamiliar pain washes over me... But why does her image overlap with Emperor Jiendia's? Why am I only sensing it now?)
(The Ellie that Iris and I are watching suddenly seems to meet our eyes. No... Surely I'm imagining it?)
You're looking at me now, Iris.
Iris... A world without pain or sorrow has been created, just as you wished.
strings.세레스 님이 사랑하는 당신, 그런 당신의 의지로 탄생한 이곳은 너무 행복: You, whom Seres loves... This place, born from your will, is such a happy one.
strings.하지만 우로보로스가 이리스의 뜻을 잘못 이해하고 깨어났어요. 모든 것이: But Ouroboros awoke, having misunderstood your wish. He means to make it a world where nothing exists.
It was because of me. I... I...
Iris, it isn't your fault. The fault lies with those who torment you.
Those who are now trying to devour your world...
strings.오딘과 니이가 과거부터 지금까지 지켜냈듯이 이리스와 %s 모두가 할 수: Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from the past until now, you and %s can do it too, Iris.
It is not your fault. You, who will become a great god...
strings.%s, 언젠가 만날 수 있을 거야. 그러기 전에 먼저 이리스의 일부터 부: %s, we'll meet someday. Until then, please help Iris first.
strings.(그 말과 함께 앞에 나타났던 인물들의 모습이 점차 사라진다.): (With those words, the figures before you gradually fade away.)
Iris, are you all right? It wasn't your fault.
A being that awoke in the world I created... Ouroboros...
strings.(이리스의 모습이 멈춘 것처럼 움직이지 않다가 갑자기 사라진다.): (Iris becomes utterly still, as though frozen in place. Then she suddenly disappears.)
strings.이리스? 어디 간 거야? 헛….. 뭐지? 이 기분은?: Iris? Where did you go? Huh...? What's this feeling?
strings.(갑자기 시야 앞에 펼쳐진 모든 것들이 일그러진다. 검은 틈이 열려 모두: (Everything before your eyes suddenly twists and warps. A black rift opens, beginning to swallow it all.)
strings.(갑자기 모로스에서 반이 사라지는 장면이 떠오른다.): (The sight of Ban disappearing in Moros suddenly flashes through your mind.)
strings.아, 안 돼!! 이곳에서 나가야 해!!: N-no! I have to get out of here!
